verdict.rationale: GitCafe's docs cover all three parts of the story: browsing files, reading commit history and inspecting single commits, and seeing who last changed each line of a file (blame). Repository pages with links to code and history are also documented. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that history and blame are web UI views rather than CLI/API features, in-depth first-party documentation of the blame view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse repository files, commit history, and line-by-line blame in the web interface

citations.quote: Browse files, compare diffs, and leave feedback alongside the code.
Read a repository's commit history, inspect a single commit, and see who last changed each line of a file.
links to its code, history, issues and pull requests
